meta.title: 长眼vs圆眼！一个视频学会两种眼妆！
meta.title_en: Long Eyes vs Round Eyes — Master Both Eye Makeup Looks

scenes.title_cn: 开场：今天分别教大家画圆眼和长眼的眼…
scenes.title_en: Opening: today I teach both round-eye and …
scenes.context: 圆眼与长眼的三条线对比。
sentences: 画眼妆可以注重三条线：眉毛、上眼形和卧蚕。
Eye makeup follows three lines: brows, upper lid, and aegyo-sal.
three lines（三条线）
既然画圆眼，那三条线的形状也要偏圆弧状的。
For round eyes, all three lines should curve.
rounded lines（圆弧线条）
用长眼画圆眼、圆眼画长眼，更有对比效果。
Drawing the long eye round and the round eye long gives better contrast.
better contrast（更有对比）
scenes.speak: Eye makeup follows three lines: brows, upper lid, and aegyo-sal. For round eyes, all three lines should curve. Drawing the long eye round and the round eye long gives better contrast.

scenes.title_cn: 圆眼打底：先用浅色以一个半圆给眼皮打…
scenes.title_en: Round-eye base: start with a light shade a…
scenes.context: 半圆打底+半圆晕染塑造圆眼。
sentences: 先用浅色以一个半圆给眼皮打底，包括下眼睑。
Start with a light half-circle base on the lid, including the lower lid.
half-circle base（半圆打底）
再用灰色系的颜色从睫毛根部画起，以小半圆画在双眼皮上方。
Then a gray tone from the lash root as a small half-circle above the crease.
small half-circle（小半圆）
从眼尾和眉尾连一条线，晕染在下眼尾，让眼尾更显圆。
Connect the outer corner to the brow tail and blend down to round the eye.
round the outer corner（眼尾更圆）
scenes.speak: Start with a light half-circle base on the lid, including the lower lid. Then a gray tone from the lash root as a small half-circle above the crease. Connect the outer corner to the brow tail and blend down to round the eye.

scenes.title_cn: 卧蚕与眼尾加深：用深色加深在睫毛根部…
scenes.title_en: Aegyo-sal and corners: deepen the lash roo…
scenes.context: 卧蚕半圆+眼头眼尾加深。
sentences: 用深色加深睫毛根部，让上眼形更外扩。
Deepen the lash root to widen the upper eye shape.
widen the upper eye（上眼形外扩）
笑一下找到卧蚕中间，以它为最低点分别向前后晕染成半圆状。
Smile to find the aegyo-sal center and blend a half-circle forward and back.
aegyo-sal center（卧蚕中间）
用淡色只提亮在卧蚕的正中间。
Brighten only the aegyo-sal center with a light shade.
brighten the center（提亮中间）
scenes.speak: Deepen the lash root to widen the upper eye shape. Smile to find the aegyo-sal center and blend a half-circle forward and back. Brighten only the aegyo-sal center with a light shade.

scenes.title_cn: 睫毛与眼线：夹好睫毛刷好睫毛打底。填…
scenes.title_en: Lashes and liner: curl and prime the lashe…
scenes.context: 竖直睫毛+短翘眼线圆眼。
sentences: 填内眼线只填在眼中间这一段，让眼珠更圆更有神。
Fill only the center segment of the inner line for a rounder, livelier iris.
center segment（眼中段）
贴竖直款的睫毛，贴完纵向拉长眼型。
Use vertical-tuft lashes that stretch the eye shape upward.
vertical lashes（竖直睫毛）
下睫毛离睫毛根部往下贴一点，会有下拉眼睑的效果。
Place lower lashes slightly lower to pull the lid down and round the eye.
pull the lid down（下拉眼睑）
scenes.speak: Fill only the center segment of the inner line for a rounder, livelier iris. Use vertical-tuft lashes that stretch the eye shape upward. Place lower lashes slightly lower to pull the lid down and round the eye.

scenes.title_cn: 眉毛与腮红：眼睛剧选有扩瞳效果且颜色…
scenes.title_en: Brows and blush: choose contacts with a pu…
scenes.context: 圆眉+团状腮红统一圆感。
sentences: 眉毛需要一个偏圆偏柔感的形状，眉中间最高两端微微下落。
Brows should be soft and rounded—highest in the middle, falling at the ends.
rounded brows（圆眉）
腮红尽量画成团状的，让眼周看起来圆乎乎的。
Draw blush in rounded blobs to keep the eye area round.
rounded blush（团状腮红）
更强调妆容显嫩显灵动的属性。
It emphasizes a fresh, lively makeup vibe.
fresh and lively（显嫩灵动）
scenes.speak: Brows should be soft and rounded—highest in the middle, falling at the ends. Draw blush in rounded blobs to keep the eye area round. It emphasizes a fresh, lively makeup vibe.

scenes.title_cn: 长眼打底：长眼的话三条线就要更偏直更…
scenes.title_en: Long-eye base: for long eyes all three lin…
scenes.context: 平行四边形+横向拉长眼型。
sentences: 长眼的话，这三条线就要更偏直、更偏长一些。
For long eyes, all three lines go straighter and longer.
straighter and longer（更直更长）
先用浅色以一个平行四边形打底。
Start with a light parallelogram base.
parallelogram（平行四边形）
用深色从眼尾平拉，拉到和眉尾差不多的长度。
Pull a deep shade from the corner to about the brow-tail length.
pull to brow tail（拉到眉尾）
paraphrase: pull to brow tail（拉到眉尾
pull to brow tail（拉到眉尾
scenes.speak: For long eyes, all three lines go straighter and longer. Start with a light parallelogram base. Pull a deep shade from the corner to about the brow-tail length.

scenes.title_cn: 长眼卧蚕与加深：眼下痣就从后眼尾连接…
scenes.title_en: Long-eye aegyo-sal and depth: connect the …
scenes.context: 平直卧蚕+眼尾上扬拉长。
sentences: 上下眼尾可以留出一点空隙，眼中更有透气感。
Leave a small gap at the outer eye for breathability.
breathable gap（透气空隙）
先平直着往前加深卧蚕，到眼尾就拐上去。
Deepen the aegyo-sal forward flat, then turn up at the corner.
turn up at the corner（眼尾拐上）
用淡色只提亮卧蚕的前半段。
Brighten only the front half of the aegyo-sal.
front half（前半段）
scenes.speak: Leave a small gap at the outer eye for breathability. Deepen the aegyo-sal forward flat, then turn up at the corner. Brighten only the front half of the aegyo-sal.

scenes.title_cn: 长眼睫毛与收尾：夹好睫毛刷好睫毛，填…
scenes.title_en: Long-eye lashes and finish: curl and prime…
scenes.context: 斜飞睫毛+锐利眉+斜扫腮红。
sentences: 下睫毛贴斜飞款，重点贴在眼尾的位置。
Use swept-back lower lashes, focused at the outer corner.
swept-back lashes（斜飞睫毛）
眼睛剧用浅色系，减少黑色眼珠的存在感。
Use light contacts to downplay the dark iris.
light contacts（浅色美瞳）
通过线性腮红去拉长，让眼尾有一个往后延伸的视觉效果。
Sweep linear blush to stretch the outer corner backward.
linear blush（线性腮红）
scenes.speak: Use swept-back lower lashes, focused at the outer corner. Use light contacts to downplay the dark iris. Sweep linear blush to stretch the outer corner backward.

scenes.title_cn: 提亮区别与总结：提亮眼角也有区分——…
sentences: 圆眼提亮更重C字提亮，去缩短中庭的比例。
Round eyes favor a C-shape highlight to shorten the mid-face.
C-shape highlight（C字提亮）
长眼更倾向于锐角提亮，让眼睛前后更有延长感。
Long eyes favor a sharp-corner highlight for front-back extension.
sharp-corner highlight（锐角提亮）
圆眼更活力可爱，长眼更清冷显贵气。
Round eyes are lively and cute; long eyes are cooler and chic.
lively vs chic（活力vs贵气）
scenes.speak: Round eyes favor a C-shape highlight to shorten the mid-face. Long eyes favor a sharp-corner highlight for front-back extension. Round eyes are lively and cute; long eyes are cooler and chic.

practice: Make the three lines round and curved.
Smile to find the aegyo-sal center and blend a half-circle.
Start with a parallelogram and pull to the brow tail.
Deepen the aegyo-sal flat, then turn up at the corner.
C-shape for round eyes, sharp corner for long.
pitfalls: Use straight shadow lines for round eyes.
Round all three lines—brow, lid, and aegyo-sal.
圆眼三条线都要圆弧状。
Fill the whole inner lash line.
Fill only the center segment for a rounder iris.
Draw long eyes with curved lines.
Use a parallelogram, straighter and longer lines.
Leave a small gap at the outer eye for breathability.
长眼上下眼尾留空隙更透气。
Use the same highlight for both eye types.
C-shape shortens the mid-face; sharp corner extends it.
圆眼C字提亮，长眼锐角提亮。
shifts: 说眼妆只会说 eye makeup
用 three lines（三条线）、aegyo-sal（卧蚕）、parallelogram（平行四边形）
说眼型只会说 eye shape
用 rounded lines（圆弧线条）、straight and long（直而长）、pull to the brow tail（拉到眉尾）
用 pupil-widening（扩瞳）、light contacts（浅色美瞳）、swept-back lashes（斜飞睫毛）
